newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit falls but recovers quickly, seen in range.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit falls but recovers quickly, seen in range.

text.p: * Ringgit fell to 2.5215 a dollar in Sydney but recovered quickly on fresh dollar selling
* Dollar fall triggered stop-loss sales around 2.5190/00
* Local corporate selling and fears of central bank intervention seen capping dollar's rise
The ringgit fell against the dollar in early Asian trading but quickly recovered on fresh dollar sales, dealers said.
"Dollar/ringgit was pushed up to 2.5215 in Sydney but came back down quickly," said a European bank dealer in Kuala Lumpur. "It triggered stop-loss dollar sales around 2.5190/00."
At 0200 GMT, the ringgit was quoted at 2.5168/78 a dollar. It closed at 2.5150/60 in Kuala Lumpur on Monday.
Dealers said fears of central bank intervention again capped the dollar's rise.
Local corporate selling around 2.5180 level would also limit dollar gains, they said.

Dealers said dollar/ringgit might again test the 2.5200 level later in London or New York. "But it will be rangebound in Kuala Lumpur with topside expected to be capped at 2.5190," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank.
Downside for dollar/ringgit is seen limited to the 2.5150 level.
